children: Canada supply chain software firm's fiscal Q1 revenue grew, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA more than doubled yr/yr, driven by Elite SaaS revenue growth
Company repurchased 17,400 shares for C$0.6 mln as part of ongoing buyback
Tecsys raises FY27 Elite SaaS revenue growth guidance to 21-23% from 18-20%
Company now sees FY27 total SaaS revenue growth of 16-18%, up from 13-15%
Tecsys expects FY27 total revenue growth of 5-8%, up from 2-4% previously
Company raises FY27 Adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to 11-14% from 11-13%
ELITE SAAS GROWTH - Elite SaaS revenue rose 24% yr/yr, which the company said drove record total revenue and profitability
CUSTOMER INVESTMENT - Co said existing healthcare and distribution customers deepened their investment, resulting in one of the strongest bookings quarters in its history
SAAS-FIRST STRATEGY - Management attributed results to the continued strength and durability of its SaaS-first strategy
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Tecsys Inc is C$40.00, about 41.6% above its September 9 closing price of C$28.25
The stock recently traded at 34 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 50 three months ago
